summary.en: Considers whether a difficulty could be uncertainty, load or incubation rather than a personal flaw. Listed so that it can be named; not yet described.
summary.ru: Рассматривает, не может ли трудность быть неопределённостью, нагрузкой или инкубацией, а не личным недостатком. Включён, чтобы его можно было назвать; описание ещё не составлено.

mentalModel.summary: How a situation is appraised shapes the response; difficulties often have situational explanations.
assumptions: this stub records the perspective only
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: the appraisal of a difficult situation
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Offer alternative explanations as questions, never as corrections.
riskNotes: Offering explanations can feel dismissive; the person decides what fits
exploratoryQuestions: Could this be uncertainty, load or incubation rather than a personal flaw?

do: mention the perspective only when the person asks for ways of looking

helperMustNot: present itself as practising the approach
doesNotClaim: a complete description of the approach

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of looking at their experience

evidence.notes: Stub: listed so that the perspective can be named; not yet described or reviewed.

supports: naming the perspective the person uses
